content: Okukora amazomu no okwiisakirya

Abhahiiri bhaane, eraabhe muraangʼure kubha omurikyeenyu asarirye, emwe bhano mukukaangatibhwa ne Ekoro Muhoreeru, mumurekye na mumukyoore kwo obhunyoohu. Nawe mwiiriihe, mutaaza mukasakibhwa kubha ne eteemo yaaye.
Mubhe muriisakirya kwo okugegerana emirigo gyeenyu emirito, hayo niho mukugukuunaania omugiro gwa Krisito.
Ambe, omuutu wowoosi wuno akwiirora kubha ano obhweera kukira abharikyaaye, wuyo atana obhweera bhwobhwoosi, ariikaangirirya.
Nawe omuutu wowoosi yiisuunze eteemo yaaye omweene. Kyeego omuutu akukora amazomu, hayo aranagya okwiikumirya amangʼana amazomu gano akoriri, atiiriingʼaania na amangʼana gano omuutu owuundi akoriri.
Kwo obhugazuro bhuyo, omuutu wowoosi areenderwa agege omurigo gwaaye omweene.
Omuutu wuno akweegibhwa engʼana ya Taatabhugya, abhe aramusoondera omweegya waaye ebhigiro bhizomu bhino abhweeni.
Mutiikaangirirya, Taatabhugya atakuzibhurwa. Kino omuutu akweemya, nikyo araagese.
Ambe, omuutu wuno akukomya enaamba yo omubhiri, nimwe araagese kusikibhwa ne enaamba yiyo. Nawe wuno akukomya Ekoro Muhoreeru, niwe araagese obhuhoru bhwa kirakeego okurwa kwe Ekoro wuyo.
Kweego, tutarosa okukora amahokya amazomu! Eraabhe turiigumiirirya kukora amazomu, turagesa bhuzomu eriibhaga ryo okugesa riraahike.
Ambe, eriibhaga ryoryoosi tukubha no omweeya, tukorere abhaatu bhoosi amazomu, kiindi abhiikirirya abharikyeetu.
Amaragiriro go okumariirya
Murore kyeego amakaamo gaane amakuru, okuhitira okubhoko kwaane omweene.
Abhaatu bhayo bhakubhasiingʼiirirya emwe musaarwe, okubha bhasuukwe na Abhayahudi. Bhareenda bhataaza bhakanyaakibhwa kwiiguru yo okurwaaza amangʼana iguru yo omusaraba gwa Krisito.
Yiingabha bhayo bhasaarirwe, naabhe ebho abheene bhatakugwaata emigiro gyoosi. Ekigiro kino bhakweenda emwe musaarwe, okubha bhiikumye iguru ye esaaro ye emibhiri gyeenyu.

Neenye, kino nitakweenda kubha ni kigiro kyo okwiikumya, nawe omusaraba gwo Omukuru weetu Yeesu Krisito. Amangʼana gano abhaatu bhe ekyaaro kino bhakugarora kubha gano obhugazuro, kweenye gatana obhugazuro bhwobhwoosi, kwe ekigirirye kyo oruku rwa Krisito kumusaraba.
Okusaarwa kasi okutama kusaarwa, bhutariho obhugazuro bhwobhwoosi bhurya. Ekigiro ekikuru ni kukorwa bhuhya na Taatabhugya.
Omureembe ne ebhigoongi bhino bhikurwa ku Taatabhugya bhibhe na abhaatu bhoosi bhano bhakuroreerera obhuheene bhuyo, bhayo nibho abhaatu bha Taatabhugya.
Ambe, kweemera bhoono omuutu wowoosi ataninyaakya kweeki, kwo okubha enye nine eziikoru zyo okutemwa na amagina ne eziityaanya mumubhiri gwaane kwiiguru yo okumuhokeerya Yeesu.
Abhahiiri bhaane, orubhaango rwo Omukuru weetu Yeesu Krisito, rubhe hamwe neemwe. Gabhe ego.

footnotes.text: Bhayo nibho abhaatu bha Taatabhugya, obhugazuro obhuundi bhuratura kubha, na Iziraeri, abhaatu bha Taatabhugya.
